question: Notion task 区间1.618测试 (owner 想办法, option 2): do open interest, long/short positioning, taker flow and funding at the touch judge whether the first weekly 1618 holds?
inputs: data.binance.vision USD-M daily metrics, monthly fundingRate, monthly 15m klines 2022-09-01..2026-09-30 via yoyo.data.binance_um_vision_fetch (local inputs, not committed).
label: Unchanged from exp-monday-1618-validity: Monday near edge before 2.0 extension, 15m conservative ordering.
primary_hypothesis: oi_since_monday lower (no new positions built into the level) -> higher validity; later-period AUC of -oi_since_monday with one-sided permutation p<0.01.
success_criterion: Model (logistic C=0.5, 8 flow features, trained before split): later AUC>=0.55 AND early-threshold top30 percent validity>=38.2 and mean R>0 AND week-stratified p<0.01.
null: Driftless barrier odds 38.2 percent for the fixed geometry; week-stratified permutation for selection.
limitations: Binance metrics are 5m snapshots with unknown publication delay (one-period lag used); 15m OHLC; independent R, fee 0.
